result.stdout:
claude-profile - create isolated Claude Code profiles

Usage:
  claude-profile create <profile-name> [options]
  claude-profile <profile-name> [options]
  claude-profile list
  claude-profile --version
  claude-profile --help

Options:
  --mcp "name=package[@version] [args]"   register a dnx MCP server (repeatable)
  --mcp-env "name=VAR1;VAR2"              copy those environment variables into
                                          that server's env block (repeatable)
  -f, --force                             overwrite a launcher not created by
                                          this tool
  -h, --help                              show this help

Environment:
  CLAUDE_PROFILE_ROOT   profile root        (default: ~/claude-profiles)
  CLAUDE_BIN_DIR        launcher directory  (default: ~/.local/bin)
  CLAUDE_EXE            Claude executable   (default: <CLAUDE_BIN_DIR>/claude[.exe])

Examples:
  claude-profile create claude-la
  claude-profile create claude-api --mcp "api=ApiMcp.Dnx@1.4.1 --yes"
  claude-profile create claude-tools ^
    --mcp "api=ApiMcp.Dnx@1.4.1 --yes --header Authorization" ^
    --mcp-env "api=AUTHORIZATION"

Run under dnx:
  dnx MultipleClaudeMcp.Cli create claude-la

The generated launcher sets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR to the profile folder,
so sessions, credentials, skills and MCP servers stay isolated.
